title: Session interaction relay
summary: Suspend the calling task for creator input, preserve interaction/task lifecycle separately, accept scoped idempotent submissions, and route confirmed canvas writes through the governed Worker commit path.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: service_for
operations.notes: No deadline. Caches only successful construction, so failed bootstrap is retried on next call; construction errors propagate.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: ToolResult model is surface-specific scalar/quad2d/layout result; editor includes interaction_id/applied_revision.

operations.notes: No deadline: waits on a human-signaled threading.Event. Uses the Host surface input/output schemas. Target inspection and state restoration can propagate additional codes; the complete embedding error set is not closed here.

operations.name: current
operations.notes: No deadline. Returns interaction null when absent, otherwise latest interaction view; may settle a stale pending interaction. Runtime contract response type is referenced, not copied. State-store failures are not a closed error set.

operations.name: submit
operations.notes: No deadline. submission_id deduplicates exact body digest and returns saved receipt; changed body conflicts. No enum exists for submission_id in this format, so idempotency is described here. Draft receipts retain only the latest 32. Confirm/apply failures propagate additional Host/Worker codes.

operations.name: prepare_ui_confirmation

identity.description: Authenticated identity from private Native route.

operations.notes: No deadline. Completed writes only; a context-local Native proof authorizes issuing an opaque credential. Plain model echo cannot mint one. Body forbids confirmation_token on this path; further current-state/input refusals propagate.

operations.name: cancel_turn
operations.notes: No deadline. Signals pending waiters and records cancelled outcome without taking the interaction lock, avoiding Worker lock inversion.

invariants.text: Creator input resumes the waiting task rather than starting provider polling.
A model or agent-facing call cannot fabricate a Native human-confirmation proof.
A repeated retained submission_id with identical data returns its receipt; different data refuses.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Governed composition commit is followed by readback validation and event/state delivery, which can still fail. This is not the spec's general staged-patch atomic replacement write protocol.
